items.body: Store event times in UTC. Preserve café names, 日本語 and 🚦 in user text.

The legacy importer may read local time only when the record includes an explicit offset.
Keep the original "timezone" field.
Historically the importer retried failed deliveries every 30 seconds; это исторический контекст.
At this recorded commit, the adapter used a bounded 30-second timeout.
